title: Euler Partition Identities for Overpartitions
description: Defines overpartitions (partitions with optional overlined parts) and formalizes their connection to Euler's partition identity.

meta.author: Corteel-Lovejoy (2004), Euler (1748)
originalContributions: Overpartition structure: partition + overlined set with subset constraint
euler_partition_identity: wrapper for Mathlib's distinct = odd
distinctToOverpartition: embedding of distinct partitions into overpartitions
overpartition_choices: 2^d choices for d distinct part sizes
meta.assumptions: 4 axioms: numOverpartitions (function), numOverpartitions_zero/one/two (small values). The function requires enumerating partitions which needs Mathlib Fintype infrastructure.

overview.historicalContext: Overpartitions were systematically studied by Corteel and Lovejoy (2004), building on Euler's 1748 partition identity. An overpartition allows the first occurrence of each part size to be optionally marked, doubling the combinatorial choices.
overview.problemStatement: How do Euler's partition identities generalize to overpartitions?
overview.text: Overpartitions extend Euler's partition framework by allowing optional marking of first occurrences.
overview.proofStrategy: Overpartitions extend Euler's partition framework by allowing optional marking of first occurrences.

crossReferences.description: Extends Euler's partition identity to overpartitions

conclusion.summary: Overpartition structure defined with connection to Euler's identity. Small values axiomatized.
conclusion.implications: Overpartition structure defined with connection to Euler's identity. Small values axiomatized.
